title: PROJECT MPG: TOWARDS A GENERALIZED PERFORMANCE BENCHMARK FOR LLM CAPABILITIES

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating models using BigBench's Bias Benchmark for QA (BBQ), presenting LLMs with contexts involving individuals of different races and comparing the model's accuracy on intentionally ambiguous questions versus unambiguous questions with clear factual details.
